summary: Stormvault is the permanent storm‑heart of the Plane of Air. Lightning‑fused chambers, cyclone corridors, and tempest‑forged platforms form a labyrinth of raw elemental force.
history: Created when primordial lightning storms condensed into a stable elemental vault.
Cyclone corridors formed as pressure currents spiraled around the vault’s core.
Stormforged guardians emerged from lightning‑infused stone and condensed air.
The Stormvault Sovereign arose as the ruler of the tempest chambers.
